instructions_to_main_agent: Use Lucide-React icons throughout (e.g. Brain, Cpu, LineChart, Sparkles, Terminal, ArrowRight, CheckCircle, Download, FolderGit2).
Make sure the navbar is fixed/sticky at the top with `z-50` and padding offset so main content is not hidden.
Implement the 'Product Thinking System' as an interactive node flow with svg connecting lines and clickable stages that show real PM methodology details.
Ensure Case Study Modals open with full project breakdown: Context, Problem, Strategy, Architecture, Outcomes/Metrics, and Tech Stack.
The AI+Automation Terminal section must feel like a real interactive developer/PM tool with executable code snippets and live output tabs.
All form fields must validate email format and non-empty inputs with clear user error messaging and toast notification via Sonner.
Ensure all interactive components have exact `data-testid` attributes as specified.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop_rule: Avoid generic centered cards, bright full-screen gradients, and plain white cards. Use rich charcoal surfaces (#121824, #161E2E) with 1px border strokes (rgba(255,255,255,0.08)) and fine emerald glow highlights.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing_philosophy: Use generous spacing (2-3x typical). Section padding py-20 to py-32. Container padding minimum p-6.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_emoji_icons: NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters like 🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🎯 in place of professional SVG icons.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_integrity: Always explicitly define text hover colors (`hover:text-white`).
